# Plasmaman
[color=#ffa500]Warning! This species is not recommended for new players due to their fatal allergy to oxygen![/color]
Plasmamen are silicon-based lifeforms that breathe [color=#ff6e26]plasma[/color] instead of oxygen. Oxygen is immediately lethal to them — contact with station air will cause them to ignite.
## Advantages
[color=#00cc66]✦ Immune to cold damage[/color] [color=#00cc66]✦ Immune to radiation damage[/color] [color=#00cc66]✦ Immune to bloodloss (no biological blood)[/color] [color=#00cc66]✦ Cannot be zombified[/color] [color=#00cc66]✦ High resistance to piercing damage (0.5×)[/color] [color=#00cc66]✦ Moderate resistance to slashing damage (0.8×)[/color] [color=#00cc66]✦ Moderate resistance to poison (0.8×)[/color]
## Disadvantages
[color=#ff4444]✦ Ignites on contact with oxygen without a sealed envirosuit[/color] [color=#ff4444]✦ Takes 1.5× damage from blunt force[/color] [color=#ff4444]✦ Takes 1.5× damage from heat[/color] [color=#ff4444]✦ Requires plasma internals at all times in oxygenated areas[/color] [color=#ff4444]✦ Normal body temperature is 270 K — far colder than most environments[/color]
## Envirosuit
Plasmamen always spawn wearing a full envirosuit tailored to their job. The suit protects them from oxygen exposure and provides a sealed environment. Each suit has [color=#ff6e26]4 self-extinguisher charges[/color] that can be activated with the suit action to put out fires.
A [color=#a0c4ff]plasmaman suit recharge crystal[/color] is included in the survival box. Use it on the jumpsuit to restore all extinguisher charges.
## Survival Box
The plasmaman survival box contains: - A breathing mask - An emergency plasma tank (spare internals) - An emergency medipen - A flare - A nutribar - A suit recharge crystal
## Breathing
Plasmamen must keep their [color=#ff6e26]plasma internals[/color] active at all times when in oxygenated areas. The suit storage slot holds a filled plasma tank. If the tank runs out, replacement plasma tanks can be found in the Atmospherics department or ordered from Cargo.
## Ignition
If a plasmaman is exposed to oxygen while missing any part of their envirosuit, they will begin to catch fire. The fire is more severe the more suit pieces are missing. Use the self-extinguisher action or the recharge crystal to manage charges.
Plasmamen are immune to plasma fire damage but are still vulnerable to regular fire.
